altan: altan — gold (noun); a man's name, as a son's name (Altan); and in Altan Qaγan the title of the Jin emperor, where the Ming glosses 金 'gold, Jin' (noun, personal name, title) [(兒)名; 金]
qučar: Qučar — Quchar, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
daritai: Daritai — Daritai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
kürün: kür- — to reach, to arrive; converb -n, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到]
baižuγ̇ui: bai- — to stand, to stop; perfect -žuγ̇ui, 'has stood, stands' (Ming 有) (verb, perfect) [立有]
kürbe: kür- — to reach, arrive; past -be, 'reached' (verb, past tense) [到了]
žebe: Žebe — Jebe, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
qubilai: Qubilai — Qubilai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
